Tara (CSM): Heads-up — Hospima dropped ~58% API usage overnight after their ML lead left. Procurement asked for a vendor cost/ops snapshot. Renewal in ~5 weeks. Can we triage and put together a retention plan? :thinking_face:
Ken (CS Ops): On it. Do we know whether traffic hit our edge errors or if keys were rotated?
Tara (CSM): Tenant shows last activity ~36h ago, no config changes in console. Champion was running batch tuning jobs. New PM hasn't responded to enablement invites.
Maya (Solutions Eng): Common culprits: token rotation, IP allowlist, or they switched to a smaller model and hit throttles. Quick test for them to run: ```curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $HOSP_TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/health``` 401/403 = token; 429 = throttling; 5xx = edge issues.
date-bot: [auto] 2025-04-11T02:15:00Z - edge incident (us-central) spike 02:12-02:20 UTC - ~1.1k requests affected.
Ken (CS Ops): Pulled tenant logs — cluster of 403s at 02:10 UTC, then retries with some 429s during the spike. Looks like key rejected then retry throttle.
Owen (AE): Procurement already saw CompetitorZ demo next week. They flagged "lower ops" and a managed connector. If this is config we fix quickly, we can keep them. Propose: 1) Offer 7-day Dedicated extension 2) 30m triage with SE 3) Benchmark summary (p50/p95, token cost, ops delta).
Maya (Solutions Eng): I'll assemble a short playbook + a tiny harness they can run: ```python
import requests, time
H={"Authorization":"Bearer $HOSP_TOKEN"}
lat=[]
for i in range(10):
 t0=time.time(); requests.post('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', headers=H, json={"model":"rwd-lite", "input":"ping"}); lat.append((time.time()-t0)*1000)
print(sorted(lat)[int(0.95*len(lat))])
```
Ken (CS Ops): Action items: @Maya one-pager + harness (ETA today EOD), I'll create a short-lived support token and flag billing to pause auto-invoice if we extend. @Tara schedule triage for Mon AM. @Owen draft benchmark note for procurement.
Tara (CSM): I'll message their PM + procurement now. If no reply by EOD escalate to exec sponsor.
Owen (AE): Will draft the benchmark and include finance contact; no pricing promises.
Maya (Solutions Eng): Initial checklist posted: 1) Validate token (401/403) 2) Confirm IP allowlist/VPN egress 3) Run health/generate checks 4) If 429 -> check tenant rate limits & request transient bump 5) Enable KV cache & batching on trial 6) Collect request IDs & logs for support
Ken (CS Ops): Noted. Also will check for residual throttles on their tenant and ensure Dedicated capacity isn't preempted.
Tara (CSM): Thanks. Aim: triage within 48h and benchmark within 72h. Will update with PM response. :white_check_mark:
